newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude says Trilogy DR+ clears FDA.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude says Trilogy DR+ clears FDA.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said its Trilogy DR+ pacemaker was cleared on Monday by the U.S. Food and Drug Administrattion for commercial sale.
Developed by St. Jude's Pacesetter unit, the device incorporates auto mode switching.
The device can alter its settings based on information it collects and analyzes about the patient's heart and the heart's interaction with the pacing system, St. Jude said.

The company said the Trilogy DR+ strengthens Pacesetter's position in the largest segment of the $1.2 billion U.S. bradycardia pacemaker market -- dual chamber rate-responsive pacing -- which represents over 50 percent of all pacemaker units sold.
St. Jude is a major medical device manufacturer.
